run_generate_asm_lcov: run the script with a callgrind folder and build folder to generate LCOV coverage output
merge_callgrind_annotate: merge multiple callgrind output files with assembly source files using callgrind_annotate
parse_callgrind_data: parse annotated execution flow data from callgrind_annotate and update per-line execution counts
generate_execution_counts: generate execution counts for all annotated assembly files from merged callgrind output
output_lcov_format: output a dictionary of filenames and execution counts as LCOV coverage format
